scenes.title: Opening Thesis
scenes.voiceText: AI success for Lakeshore is not a chatbot. It is a governed execution layer for treasury, vendors, risk, decisions, and measurable value.

scenes.title: Lakeshore Operating Profile
scenes.voiceText: AbarVa starts with Lakeshore's facts: companies, revenue baseline, people, systems, vendors, banks, and board priorities. Context comes before AI.
scenes.cameraTarget: planning profile metrics and company cards

scenes.title: Federated Complexity
scenes.voiceText: The complexity is the product opportunity: sponsor decisions, HoldCo autonomy, PortCo systems, CXO ownership, contracts, CMDB, and process evidence.

scenes.title: Lakeshore Intelligence Layer
scenes.voiceText: The intelligence layer is the moat: tenant context, role context, evidence, corpus doctrine, workflow state, and value ledger working together.

scenes.title: Editable Corpus Doctrine
scenes.voiceText: The corpus stays editable. Lakeshore leaders approve, refine, localize, or retire doctrine as the portfolio learns what actually works.

scenes.title: Kyriba And Treasury Wedge
scenes.voiceText: Kyriba fails when bank, ERP, entity, cash, control, and adoption facts surface too late. AbarVa turns them into gates.

scenes.title: Beyond Kyriba
scenes.voiceText: Kyriba is the opening wedge. The broader platform finds value across treasury, vendors, IT, cyber, operations, and growth AI.

scenes.title: $500K Value Case
scenes.voiceText: The five hundred thousand dollar case is about five to ten times value potential: avoid rollout failure, rationalize vendors, reduce execution cost, and prove savings.

scenes.title: Move Execution Proof
scenes.voiceText: A Move converts insight into owned work: phase, evidence, value, gaps, artifacts, and a next action.
scenes.cameraTarget: Move product screen and ownership cards

scenes.title: Source Decision Proof
scenes.voiceText: Source turns finance, procurement, and executive judgment into a decision path with evidence, guardrails, and required artifacts.

scenes.title: Value Pipeline Proof
scenes.voiceText: The value story is controlled: forecast, approval, negotiated outcome, and finance-accepted proof stay separate.

scenes.title: Architecture Trust Layer
scenes.voiceText: Claude can reason. AbarVa governs what it can see, cite, create, and persist for board and audit use.

scenes.title: Six-Month Roadmap
scenes.voiceText: The six-month roadmap builds context, corpus, finance proof, Source events, execution rhythm, and a board-ready value pack.

scenes.title: Renewal Standard
scenes.voiceText: By month six, the renewal case should be earned: coverage, proof, value pipeline, and a finance-defensible ledger.
